In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 3-space]], the '''order-7 dodecahedral honeycomb''' is a regular space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]).

== Geometry==
With [[Schläfli symbol]] {5,3,7}, it has seven [[dodecahedra]] {5,3} around each edge. All vertices are ultra-ideal (existing beyond the ideal boundary) with infinitely many dodecahedra existing around each vertex in an [[order-7 triangular tiling]] [[vertex arrangement]].

|[[File:H3_537_UHS_plane_at_infinity.png|240px]]<BR>Ideal surface
|}

== Related polytopes and honeycombs ==
It a part of a sequence of [[regular polytope]]s and honeycombs with [[Dodecahedron|dodecahedral]] [[cell (geometry)|cells]], {5,3,''p''}.
{{Dodecahedral tessellations small}}

It a part of a sequence of honeycombs {5,''p'',7}.

In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 3-space]], the '''order-8 dodecahedral honeycomb''' a regular space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]). With [[Schläfli symbol]] {5,3,8}, it has eight [[dodecahedra]] {5,3} around each edge. All vertices are ultra-ideal (existing beyond the ideal boundary) with infinitely many dodecahedra existing around each vertex in an [[order-8 triangular tiling]] [[vertex arrangement]].

{| class=wikitable width=480
|[[File:Hyperbolic honeycomb 5-3-8 poincare cc.png|240px]]<BR>[[Poincaré disk model]]<BR>Cell-centered
|[[File:Hyperbolic honeycomb 5-3-8 poincare.png|240px]]<BR>Poincaré disk model
<!--|[[File:H3_538_UHS_plane_at_infinity.png|240px]]<BR>Ideal surface-->
|}

It has a second construction as a uniform honeycomb, [[Schläfli symbol]] {5,(3,4,3)}, Coxeter diagram, {{CDD|node_1|5|node|split1|branch|label4}}, with alternating types or colors of dodecahedral cells.
{{Clear}}

In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 3-space]], the '''infinite-order dodecahedral honeycomb''' a regular space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]). With [[Schläfli symbol]] {5,3,∞}. It has infinitely many [[dodecahedra]] {5,3} around each edge. All vertices are ultra-ideal (existing beyond the ideal boundary) with infinitely many dodecahedra existing around each vertex in an [[infinite-order triangular tiling]] [[vertex arrangement]].

{| class=wikitable width=600
|[[File:Hyperbolic honeycomb 5-3-i poincare cc.png|200px]]<BR>[[Poincaré disk model]]<BR>Cell-centered
|[[File:Hyperbolic honeycomb 5-3-i poincare.png|200px]]<BR>Poincaré disk model
|[[File:H3_53i_UHS_plane_at_infinity.png|200px]]<BR>Ideal surface
|}
It has a second construction as a uniform honeycomb, [[Schläfli symbol]] {5,(3,∞,3)}, Coxeter diagram, {{CDD|node_1|5|node|split1|branch|labelinfin}}, with alternating types or colors of dodecahedral cells.
